title: Synthetic Paper A: Classroom Feedback
abstract: Students used automated feedback in writing classes. The study compared revision quality before and after feedback. Results suggest improved revisions, but the sample was limited to one class.

title: Synthetic Paper B: Teacher Dashboards
abstract: Teachers used a learning dashboard to monitor participation. Interviews described useful alerts and concerns about privacy. The work did not compare outcomes across schools.

title: Synthetic Paper C: Tutoring Chatbots
abstract: A tutoring chatbot answered students' questions in an online course. The evaluation measured response quality and satisfaction. Few participants reported long-term learning outcomes.
